notes.title: Counterspell v1.2 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Performance[/h3]

[list]
[*] Doubled performance by optimizing character assets and various VFX. The game should now run more smoothly on older devices and more consistently overall. 
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where Squana was able to hold opponents with her ability, indefinitely. Bloodlust now decreases accordingly as the ability is held.
[/list]

notes.title: Counterspell v1.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

[list]
[*]Increased physics update rate from 50 fps to 60 fps. Should result in visibly smoother motion as well as slightly more responsive and precise movement.
[*]Actions that decrease bloodlust, such as shielding or running away from the opponent, will no longer decrease bloodlust past already earned stocks. This means players only lose access to their character's bloodlust ability when they use it.
[*]Decreased actionable spawn protection duration from 1 second to 0.5 seconds.
[*]Decreased bloodlust reward for hitting hazard buttons from 2.5 to 1.
[*]Decreased bloodlust reward for killing a player with a kill dash from 17.5 to 15.
[*]Balance changes to bloodlust abilities:

[b]Cosmosis[/b]
Cost: 40 → 30
Stocks: 3 → 1
No longer hits invincible or respawning players
No longer afflicts status on shielding players

[b]Fuller[/b]
Cost: 35 → 28

[b]Ignis[/b]
Cost: 25 → 30

[b]Squana[/b]
Cost: 25 → 20
[/list]

[h3]Performance[/h3]

[list]
[*] Reduced the overall amount of VRAM and RAM usage. Depending on players' system specs, this might result in improved frame rates and/or decreased load times. 
[/list]

[h3]Visuals[/h3]

[list]
[*] Shields now fade out smoothly before disappearing, instead of "popping" out of existence.
[*] Adjusted Pestis' animation transitions.
[/list]

notes.title: Counterspell v1.09b - Patch Notes
notes.content:
This patch addresses a number of small bugs.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where in certain team game modes scores/placement were not displayed correctly at the end of a match.
[*] Fixed an issue where in certain game modes incorrect graphics were shown at the end of a match.
[*] Fixed an issue with achievements not unlocking as intended.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for supporting Counterspell.
